ios.desc:
Palmist is the #1 app for palm reading, predictions, and answers to the questions that matter most. Join over 1.2M people who plan their lives with more confidence using our AI-powered palm-reading algorithms, guided readings, future event predictions, biorhythm charts, compatibility analysis, and in-depth personality insights.

WHY PALMIST
A wealth of features awaits — unlike anything you’ll find in other apps. You’ll explore any part of your life: love, family, having children, career, business success, financial well-being, relocations, travel, and much more. By comparing every detail of your hands and analyzing the shape and direction of each palm line, Palmist gives you a clear bearing and a focused answer. Trust Palmist as a steady companion you can confide in — one that helps you find a way forward in difficult moments.

AI PALM READER
Receive daily predictions and answers to your questions. Palmist has a built-in AI that can help untangle even the most complicated situations. An exclusive AI Palm Reader feature has no equivalent on the App Store. All predictions and forecasts are guaranteed to guide you in your life.

HAND READING
Explore a complete hand reading with clear explanations for every detail. Learn what your hand type and shape suggest, how your fingers, phalanges, and fingerprints are structured, what each palm line means, and how to read the signs that appear on the lines. See how all these features connect to form a unique picture of your personality.

LIFE EVENTS
A dedicated Life Events section highlights key milestones across your personal, love/family, and professional life. You’ll find detailed predictions for many possible life events — so you can understand your potential and move forward with confidence.

BIORHYTHMS
Plan your life effectively with daily charts for your physical, sexual, intellectual, emotional, creative, intuitive, and spiritual activity levels. With Biorhythms, you can also calculate compatibility with anyone — see what you share, where you differ, and plan time together.

FIND COMPATIBLE PEOPLE
Find new friends and communicate with them thanks to the Search for Compatible People feature. Now you can find new friends, reliable business partners, or even find your love anywhere in the world. This is one of Palmist’s key goals — to help connect the most compatible people.

KEY HIGHLIGHTS
• Private chat with a professional AI palmist
• Answers to any questions
• Life event forecasts
• Detailed palm reading
• Hand
